title: Tiny Hat
excerpt: A Linux distro for 32-bit and 64-bit x86 computers. Intended for retro gaming and retro game development (DOS, GBA, SNES, NES, TIC-80, CHIP-8, C64 and ZX Spectrum). The image is signed and fully reproducible.
content_html:
• A Linux distro for 32-bit and 64-bit x86 computers.
  • Intended for retro gaming and retro game development (DOS, GBA, SNES, NES, TIC-80, CHIP-8, C64 and ZX Spectrum).
  • The image is signed and fully reproducible.
  • Uses less than 100M RAM after booting (87M on the 32-bit version, right over 100M on the 64-bit version).
  • Uses just a bit more than 600M disk space, and is fully usable on a 1G memory stick.
  • Works better than MS-DOS and FreeDOS for playing games on the old x86 retro gaming computer I created the distro for (because of hardware support).
  • Comes with modern libraries, like SDL3, Pipewire and Raylib. Uses dwl and Wayland.
  • Comes with the Orbiton editor and an easy way to compile and run C programs, DOS Assembly programs, GBA programs and also LÖVE+Fennel programs.
  • Some applications that comes with the i686 version requires SSE right now, but that will be fixed in the next release.
  • There is support for aarch64 and rpi4, but it is experimental.

Release page: https://github.com/xyproto/tinyhat/releases
content_text: A Linux distro for 32-bit and 64-bit x86 computers. Intended for retro gaming and retro game development (DOS, GBA, SNES, NES, TIC-80, CHIP-8, C64 and ZX Spectrum). The image is signed and fully reproducible. Uses less than 100M RAM after booting (87M on the 32-bit version, right over 100M on the 64-bit version). Uses just a bit more than 600M disk space, and is fully usable on a 1G memory stick. Works better than MS-DOS and FreeDOS for playing games on the old x86 retro gaming computer I created the distro for (because of hardware support). Comes with modern libraries, like SDL3, Pipewire and Raylib. Uses dwl and Wayland. Comes with the Orbiton editor and an easy way to compile and run C programs, DOS Assembly programs, GBA programs and also LÖVE+Fennel programs. Some applications that comes with the i686 version requires SSE right now, but that will be fixed in the next release. There is support for aarch64 and rpi4, but it is experimental. Release page: https://github.com/xyproto/tinyhat/releases
